items.name: TableReference
items.summary: A multi part identifier (path) to a table that may require further resolution (e.g. `foo.bar`).

methods.name: catalog
methods.summary: Retrieve the catalog name if  [`Self::Full`], `None` otherwise.

methods.name: full
methods.signature: fn full(catalog: impl Into<Arc<str>>, schema: impl Into<Arc<str>>, table: impl Into<Arc<str>>) -> TableReference

methods.name: none
methods.summary: Convenience method for creating a typed none `None`

methods.name: parse_str
methods.summary: Forms a [`TableReference`] by parsing `s` as a multipart SQL identifier, normalizing `s` to lowercase. See docs on [`TableReference`] for more details.

methods.name: parse_str_normalized
methods.summary: Forms a [`TableReference`] by parsing `s` as a multipart SQL identifier, normalizing `s` to lowercase if `ignore_case` is `false`. See docs on [`TableReference`] for more details.

methods.name: partial
methods.signature: fn partial(schema: impl Into<Arc<str>>, table: impl Into<Arc<str>>) -> TableReference

methods.name: resolve
methods.summary: Given a default catalog and schema, ensure this table reference is fully resolved

methods.name: resolved_eq
methods.summary: Compare with another [`TableReference`] as if both are resolved. This allows comparing across variants. If a field is not present in both variants being compared then it is ignored in the comparison.

methods.name: schema
methods.summary: Retrieve the schema name if [`Self::Partial]` or [`Self::`Full`], `None` otherwise.

methods.name: table
methods.summary: Retrieve the table name, regardless of qualification.

methods.name: to_quoted_string
methods.summary: Forms a string where the identifiers are quoted

methods.name: to_vec
methods.summary: Decompose a [`TableReference`] to separate parts. The result vector contains at most three elements in the following sequence: ```no_rust [<catalog>, <schema>, table] ```

items.name: ResolvedTableReference
items.summary: A fully resolved path to a table of the form "catalog.schema.table"
